# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 21 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Aseneth Intercedes; Pharaoh's Son Dies; Pharaoh Dies

---

**21:1** And Simeon and Levi and their brothers wanted to kill the son of Pharaoh, but Aseneth said: 'Do not render evil for evil to any man, for the Lord God will avenge this wrong himself, so do not kill him.'

**21:2** And they obeyed Aseneth and left the son of Pharaoh lying on the ground, half dead.

**21:3** And Dan and Gad came and threw themselves before Aseneth on the ground and said to her: 'Have mercy on us, your servants, for we have done evil to you and to your husband Joseph, and have plotted wicked things against you. But now do not repay us for our wickedness, for we see that the Lord God fights for you.'

**21:4** And Aseneth said to them: 'Be of good courage and do not be afraid, for your brother Joseph is a God-fearing man, and he will not repay evil for evil to any man. Go and do not fear.'

**21:5** And they rejoiced and arose from the ground and bowed before Aseneth and went away.

**21:6** And after three days the son of Pharaoh died from the wound that Benjamin inflicted on him.

**21:7** And Pharaoh heard what his son had done against Joseph and Aseneth, and he was very grieved and became ill, and he died after a few days, being one hundred and nine years old.

**21:8** And Joseph took the crown of Pharaoh and placed it upon his own head and reigned over Egypt for forty-eight years.

**21:9** And after all this Joseph and Aseneth lived in peace.

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
